description:
[read-only] Whether each connected network and ad account can run ads, and what to fix first. Pass `objective` (the campaign objective, e.g. `lead_generation` for an Instant Form campaign) before activating: each check then says whether it `blocks` that objective or is `advisory`, and `overall` counts only the blocking ones. A blocking check in state `manual` is not readable by API: confirm it on the platform.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/readiness.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand. A brand-bound key is always pinned to its brand; any other value is 403.

objective.description: The campaign objective to check readiness for. Omit for the every-objective verdict, where the pixel, domain and business verification all block.

name: ads_readiness
title: Ads readiness
